```artifact
Feature: System Security and Functionality

  Scenario: Chemist and Lab Login
    Given the system is up and running
    When a Chemist or Lab logs in with valid credentials
    Then the system should allow access to the Prescriptions

  Scenario: Patient Login
    Given the system is up and running
    When a Patient logs in with valid credentials
    Then the system should allow access to the Prescriptions

  Scenario: Email Notification for Patients
    Given a Patient has a valid email address
    When a prescription is generated for the Patient
    Then an email should be sent to the Patient's email address
    And the email should contain the full prescription and Invoice

  Scenario: Payment Gateway Integration
    Given the system is up and running
    When a Patient clicks the payment button
    Then the system should redirect to the Payment Gateway
    And the payment should be securely accepted via Debit/Credit Cards and Net banking

  Scenario: Data Isolation
    Given a Chemist or Lab logs in
    When the Chemist or Lab attempts to access a Patient's data
    Then the system should deny access
    And the Chemist or Lab should receive an error message

  Scenario: Invalid User Login
    Given the system is up and running
    When an invalid user attempts to log in
    Then the system should deny access
    And the system should display an error message

  Scenario: Invalid Password Login
    Given the system is up and running
    When a valid user attempts to log in with an invalid password
    Then the system should deny access
    And the system should display an error message

  Scenario: Payment Gateway Decline
    Given the system is up and running
    When a Patient attempts to make a payment with a declined card
    Then the system should display an error message
    And the payment should not be processed

  Scenario Outline: Browser Compatibility
    Given the system is up and running
    When a user logs in using <browser>
    Then the system should allow access to the Prescriptions
    Examples:
      | browser       |
      | Google Chrome |
      | Mozilla Firefox |
      | Safari        |

  Scenario Outline: OS Compatibility
    Given the system is up and running
    When a user logs in using <OS>
    Then the system should allow access to the Prescriptions
    Examples:
      | OS             |
      | Windows        |
      | macOS          |
      | Linux          |
```
